name: IDRiD batch 2 -- cross-dataset evaluation of the frozen EyePACS-adapted graders P-EP, E1-EP and E2-EP (P reused from the earlier run)

parent_protocol.note: the dataset (image-set and label-file hashes, the three primary exclusions), Stage-2 preprocessing, the 512 RGB frame, the inference settings, the decoding rule, the bootstrap and the parity tolerances are the parent protocol's, unchanged

models.p: ImageNet ConvNeXt-Tiny + CORN, RGB. NOT run: the per-image tables stored by the earlier one-time run are reused
models.p_ep: P trained on APTOS from the pinned EyePACS-adapted encoder with a fresh CORN head (pl_convnext P graph)
models.e1_ep: E1 trained on APTOS from the same adapted encoder: 1x1 lesion head on aligned Stage-4 targets (e1_model). Only the grading output is read
models.e2_ep: E1-EP with deranged training lesion targets (control). Same model definition. Only the grading output is read

adapted_encoder.note: the one EyePACS adaptation checkpoint every EP run started from (record 72)

stored_p_tables.note: made at commit 6a88636 under TensorFlow 2.20.0 / Keras 3.13.2; float16 differences of about one logit step are possible between runtimes

pipeline.stage2: stage4_v2_data.stage2_rgb: DR profile, once, native size
pipeline.rgb_frame: stage4_v2_aptos_cache.recompute_rgb_512: full-frame direct resize to 512x512 (no crop), float32 [0,1]
pipeline.stage3: not run (all three arms take RGB only)
pipeline.stage4: not run (all three arms take RGB only); no Stage-3 or Stage-4 cache is read
pipeline.model: p_ep: pl_convnext.build_pl_model('P') through P's three inputs (RGB in the first three channels, the rest zero); e1_ep, e2_ep: e1_model.build_e1_model, output 0 (CORN logits). mixed_float16; BEST weights
pipeline.decode: cumulative p_k = cumprod(sigmoid(logits)); grade = number of k with p_k > 0.5

parity.raw_subset: the first two images of every grade in the authoritative 730-image validation order (10 images), from the RAW files: Stage 2 exact against the stored Stage-2 file, RGB frame within rgb_max_abs of the cache
parity.full_validation: all 730 validation images from the cached RGB frames against each model's stored BEST validation table, authoritative order
parity.tolerances: parent protocol: rgb_max_abs 1e-06, logit_max_abs 0.05, probability_max_abs 0.01, grades identical

comparisons.note: paired on the same images and the same seed. P-EP - P is the external form of Q1 (does DR-specific adaptation change cross-dataset grading); E1-EP - P-EP is the grading effect of aligned lesion supervision after adaptation. The two contrasts with E2-EP are descriptive. No superiority, equivalence or non-inferiority criterion is defined.

analysis_sets.sensitivity: all 103 images, computed after the primary result and labelled as sensitivity

disclosures: IDRiD's grading test set has been used twice before in this project: once (record 61) for an earlier frozen pipeline and its P reference, and once (record 67, batch 1) for E1 and E2. This is its third and last declared use.
The nine EP checkpoints were never evaluated on IDRiD before this run and were not tuned, selected or modified using IDRiD.

This is therefore a cross-dataset evaluation of models fixed beforehand, on a dataset the project has already used -- not an untouched project-level test, and the batch-1 result (E1 lower than P in decoded grades) was known when this batch was planned.

Stage 4, which supplied the lesion targets of E1-EP (and, deranged, of E2-EP), was trained on IDRiD segmentation images and so on IDRiD's camera domain. No EP model saw an IDRiD image, but this indirect exposure is not shared by P or P-EP and is a limitation.
The three test images that are copies of Stage-4 training images are excluded from the primary analysis.
P's predictions are those stored by the earlier run (TensorFlow 2.20.0); P was not run again.
All nine EP models start from ONE EyePACS-adapted encoder: their seed-to-seed spread does not include the variance of the adaptation.
APTOS validation was the checkpoint-selection set of every model here; EyePACS validation selected the adapted encoder.
The primary set has 100 images (19 of grade 3, 13 of grade 4): small differences cannot be resolved, and intervals are descriptive of this sample.
No non-inferiority or equivalence margin was pre-specified; none is tested or claimed. The evaluation says nothing about clinical utility.
rules: no repeated runs for better numbers
a rerun only for a technical failure, with the reason recorded
nothing about P, P-EP, E1-EP, E2-EP or any recorded conclusion (records 70, 74-77) is changed on the basis of this result
